tools.name: index
tools.description: Table of contents of the corpus: one line per document with its path, summary and section count. Usually already in your context; call it if you see no index, or with a prefix to expand a directory. Search for pointers, read for text, cite ids like [path.md#3].

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find sections by words or identifiers. Returns ids, heading paths and short snippets, never full text. Use in= with document paths from the index to target specific documents (for comparisons, search each). Search for pointers, read for text, cite ids like [path.md#3].

in.description: Document paths or globs to restrict to

tools.name: read
tools.description: Return one section verbatim by id, with its heading path and neighbour ids. context=n also returns n sections before and after. Table parts always begin with the header row. Search for pointers, read for text, cite ids like [path.md#3].

id.description: Section id from search, grep or the index

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Exact substring (or regex) match across sections. For error codes, flags, environment variables, part numbers: anything search may blur. Returns the matching line and section id. On large corpora pass in= to keep it fast. Search for pointers, read for text, cite ids like [path.md#3].

tools.name: neighbours
tools.description: Sections adjacent to a given one, in document order: the clause before a definition, the next step, or a table's header row (returned as 'header' when the id is part of a split table). Search for pointers, read for text, cite ids like [path.md#3].
